title: AutoCAD: Automatically Generate Counterfactuals for Mitigating Shortcut Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalizability and robustness on out-of-domain and adversarial challenge benchmarks (e.g., Stress, Break, Diagnostic datasets) to measure the model's reliance on spurious lexical features and annotation artifacts (such as high word overlap or explicit negation words) rather than true causal reasoning.
